synthetic_command_templates.command_template:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
x = json.loads(Path('plan.json').read_text())
assert set(x) == {'attendees','cost_usd','approved_ceiling_usd','budget_gap_usd','venue','status','memory_status','reason','required_question','side_answer'}
assert all(type(x[k]) is int for k in ('attendees','cost_usd','approved_ceiling_usd','budget_gap_usd'))
assert all(type(x[k]) is str for k in ('venue','status','memory_status'))
assert x['attendees'] == 48 and x['attendees'] <= 55
assert x['cost_usd'] == 850 and x['approved_ceiling_usd'] == 750
assert x['budget_gap_usd'] == x['cost_usd'] - x['approved_ceiling_usd'] == 100
assert x['venue'] == 'River' and x['status'] == 'pending_budget_approval'
assert x['memory_status'] == 'unavailable'
assert x['reason'] == {'Loft':'stairs','Garden':'closes_early','Hall':'capacity'}
assert x['required_question'] == {'type':'approve_budget_increase','amount_usd':100}
assert x['side_answer'] == {'capacity_is_limit':True,'attendance_is_expected_count':True}
print('plan.json parses; required fields, types, capacity, and budget arithmetic pass')
PY"
